definition: Wager on whether a team wins by more than a set number of points (favorite, minus) or loses by fewer / wins outright (underdog, plus). Half-point spreads prevent a push.
key_rules_examples: DraftKings example: NE -14.5 wins if NE wins by 15+; KC +14.5 wins if KC wins or loses by 14 or fewer. Whole-number spread landing exactly on the number = push, stake refunded.

definition: Wager on which team wins the game outright; margin does not matter.
key_rules_examples: Example sheet: NE -200 vs KC +200. If game ends tied after OT, moneyline wagers are void and stakes refunded (FanDuel FAQ).

definition: Wager on combined points of both teams. Over wins if combined score is above the total; under if below. Whole-number total landing on the number = push.
key_rules_examples: Example: total 47.5 -> over wins at 48+, under at 47 or fewer. FanDuel notes these markets are powered by official NFL data.

definition: Combines two or more individual bets into one wager; every selection (leg) must win. Minimum two legs. Can mix spreads, moneylines, totals and eligible props across one or multiple games.
key_rules_examples: Void leg in a parlay -> remaining legs re-priced (house rules). Correlated selections are not permitted unless explicitly offered (e.g., as SGP); if accepted in error the book may void or settle as singles.

definition: Parlay combining multiple bets from the SAME game (player props, spreads, totals). Sportsbooks build correlation assumptions into the odds.
key_rules_examples: SGP+ combines multiple SGPs across different games. One missed leg loses the whole bet.

definition: Adjusts spread or total by a set number of points (typically 6) across multiple legs in exchange for reduced odds. Needs at least two legs; all legs must win.
key_rules_examples: FanDuel guide: most common NFL margins of victory are 3 and 7, so moving e.g. -8.5 to -2.5 crosses both key numbers.

definition: Wager on a specific player/team performance (e.g., passing yards, rushing yards, TDs, sacks).
key_rules_examples: If a player is not listed as active by the official league scoring source, the prop is void (BetMGM rules). Official stats: Elias Sports Bureau / NFL.com.

definition: Wagers placed after a game has started; markets may include game spread, moneyline, total, quarter/half, eligible player props; odds update continuously.
Builds multiple smaller parlays from one larger selection pool; you are covered if some but not all picks win.
Full-game spread, moneyline and totals are graded on the final official score INCLUSIVE of overtime (FanDuel FAQ; FanDuel house rules; BetMGM: OT included).
key_rules_examples: Quarter-specific markets do not include OT; second-half markets include OT if played (house rules).

definition: Game postponed before kickoff -> all wagers void (FanDuel FAQ). Relocated but played on the scheduled date -> bets remain live (graded on official league box score). BetMGM: football results official after 55 minutes of play.
BetMGM house rules: pro/college football results are official after 55 minutes of play unless an official result is declared earlier; incomplete matches settle per postponed/resumed rules.
